welcome: Hello, {name}! 📚 Welcome to KITOBXON AI — professional book discovery and exploration platform. I can help you search books worldwide, view authors, descriptions, analyses, and legal reading resources. To search, simply send a book title, author name, or ISBN number!
help_text: 📖 KITOBXON AI — Help Guide Search options: • Full or partial book title (e.g., To Kill a Mockingbird) • Author name (e.g., Harper Lee) • ISBN number (e.g., 9780061120084) • Latin or Cyrillic script supported Commands: /start — Open main menu /search — Search for books /favorites — Your saved books /profile — Your profile and reading statistics /recommend — Book recommendations /language — Switch language /help — This help guide /cancel — Cancel current action
